title: AWS Marketplace Event Handling Result
description: 200 response for POST /api/v1/billing/marketplace/events. `result` is the exact vocabulary returned by handle_marketplace_event: duplicate (event id already recorded, no-op), ignored (recorded but outside RESYNC_EVENTS), unknown_customer (no linked customer yet, but a live pending registration explains it -- acknowledged, not urgent), orphaned_purchase (no linked customer and no live pending registration -- dead-lettered, processed=False, for operator follow-up via GET /billing/dead-letter-events), processed (resynced entitlements for a known linked customer). See src/services/billing/aws_marketplace/events.py.
